features.name: Fork update isolation
integrationEvidence: fast-gate update/release tests reached green after derivative adaptation
features.notes: No upstream StarNet update endpoint remains authoritative; updater artifacts remain disabled until derivative signing exists.

features.name: Commander/Manager/Specialist/Worker organizational roles
integrationEvidence: real Recruitment Bay classes resolve through the shared org-specialties catalog so Team Lead maps to manager and bounded collector/tester/writer classes map to worker
team.summon receives the same shared organizational class metadata and explicitly states that role metadata does not grant capabilities
browser summon persistence writes orgRole and the requesting agent as explicit parentAgentId; Control Mode reads the same durable roster after restart
Moe AI Station CI, eval-gates, fast-gate and secret-history passed on the integrated role-aware branch
features.notes: Commander/Manager/Specialist/Worker are first-class organizational metadata layered over legacy orchestrator/specialist runtime roles. Hierarchy never grants tools or approvals; capability and consent gates remain authoritative.

features.name: Managed delegation with typed task contracts
integrationEvidence: Moe AI Station CI runtime wiring, inherited orchestration and security-boundary suites passed
features.notes: Uses inherited team.dispatch executor and preserves consent/capability gates.

features.name: Deterministic acceptance/revision gate
integrationEvidence: managed delegation invokes deterministic review before optional auditor
features.notes: Bounded revisions; budget and acceptance evidence are host-validated.

features.name: Independent auditor stage
integrationEvidence: worker self-audit and lead self-audit are rejected before audit dispatch
features.notes: Auditor result is structured and host-validated.

features.name: Persistent managed-task history
integrationEvidence: sidecar/index.js composes one managedTaskHistoryHost from the canonical workspace and injects its singleton store into team.delegate_managed
GET /api/managed-tasks supports bounded history, summary, active telemetry and exact task drilldown without mutation routes
Moe AI Station CI verifies durable disk history, bounded live lifecycle, metrics, HTTP and host composition
features.notes: Durable completion history and bounded in-flight telemetry share one host composition seam; unknown/unavailable live state is reported honestly rather than synthesized.

features.name: Control Mode telemetry API
integrationEvidence: Control Mode consumes GET-only managed-task summary, active, recent and exact drilldown endpoints
agent organization endpoint projects the authoritative roster with explicit org-role/parent metadata and shared live runtime status
SYSTEM dock bootstraps the tested pure projection layer, task dashboard and organization pane without mutation controls
Moe AI Station CI, eval-gates, fast-gate and secret-history are green on the integrated branch head
features.notes: V1 is intentionally read-only: task/agent telemetry is observable, bounded and evidence-backed; no dispatch, approve, reject, cancel, steer or hierarchy mutation controls are exposed.

features.name: Verified read-only Control Mode surfaces
integrationEvidence: six dedicated Control Mode projections are wired as GET/HEAD-only surfaces against existing authoritative runtime stores
aggregate E2E, schema, lifecycle and HTTP-failure contracts verify fail-closed behavior instead of fabricated empty state
desktop and website surfaces are byte-mirrored and the accessibility contract verifies dialog focus restoration, keyboard drilldown and semantic section labels
provider signals combine only registry metadata and observed rate-limit evidence; health, credential validity, uptime, latency, success rate and health scores are never inferred
features.notes: The verified v1 boundary is intentionally observe-only. Agents, memory provenance, approvals, action trace, costs and provider signals expose evidence-backed state without adding mutation controls or parallel truth stores.

features.name: Derivative installer/update signing
features.notes: Updater artifacts intentionally disabled until own signing keys and release channel exist.

features.name: Complete derivative branding and artwork replacement
features.notes: StarNet name/logo/station artwork are not licensed as derivative brand assets and must be fully replaced before distribution.

features.name: Safe app identity and data-path migration
features.notes: Do not change package/app identifiers until migration preserves existing workspaces and credentials.
